reviewNotes: HOLD - The official University of Guyana catalogue and School of Medicine pages confirm a face-to-face, five-year MBBS. The university's current tuition pages publish first-year medicine fees and the mandatory facilities fee; its MBBS admission page sets out selection criteria and notes that eligibility does not guarantee a place. CAAM-HP lists the University of Guyana School of Medicine as Accreditation with Conditions for 2024-2028. Hold pending a complete current international application calendar/document list, an all-years cost card, accommodation/visa support evidence, and target-market licensing analysis.
